about: Training runs for the learned field model (docs/learned-models.md); written by Scripts/ml/field-runs.py plan. Estimates are for the Studio's M4 Max, one run at a time; the CI mini takes about 3-4 times as long.

costModel.calibratedOn: the six smoke runs on the Studio, 20 Oct 2026: 0.46-0.65 ns a cell-step quiet, 1.0-1.3 with the cold start and other jobs; 573 steps a simulated second on 4 m cells; the solver 73 bytes a cell; Beirut's 12,000 x 12,000 height grid takes 17-40 s to read
